title: Foreskin Warrior — Episode 1: First Battle: The Company Bath
description: Night two of the company trip. I stood in front of the cloth curtain that hangs over the entrance to the hotel's big shared bath. This is a battlefield. And I am a warrior.
markdown:
Night two of the company trip. I stood in front of the cloth curtain that hangs over the entrance to the hotel's big shared bath.

This is a battlefield. And I am a warrior.

I have one thing to protect. Nobody can ever find out about my tight foreskin.

I've kept that secret for thirty-one years. I wasn't about to lose tonight.

"Hey, come on, let's go."

Mori, who joined the company the same year I did, slapped me on the shoulder.

Here it comes. Enemy number one.

"Go ahead. I need to check my phone's charging."

Special move: the Delayed Entry. Wait until everyone's in the water, then undress. The basic stance.

Five minutes later, I walked into the changing room. Just as planned, almost everyone was already inside.

Good. Now.

Before I even slipped off my hotel cotton robe, I wrapped a towel around my waist. Two towels, actually.

Special move: the Double Towel Barrier. Nobody has ever broken through it.

I checked the knot twice and opened the door to the battlefield.

Through the steam, I saw my section chief's back.

At a Japanese bath, you scrub down on a little stool at a shower before you're allowed in the hot tub. I took the shower at the very back.

With the wall behind me, the enemy could only come from the front.

Special move: the Back Wall Position.

Even while I washed, the towel stayed on. So what if it got cold.

Then Mori sat down next to me, his head covered in shampoo.

"Dude, why are you washing with a towel on?"

A beat.

My heart went hotter than the bath.

Stay calm. A warrior never lets it show.

"I get cold easily. Always have."

Special move: the Cold Body Shield. That excuse has saved me more times than I can count.

"Cold? We're at a hot spring, man."

Mori laughed. A couple of the other guys seemed to glance over.

They saw. No. Not yet. The towel held.

"Aren't you getting in the tub?"

This time it was one of the younger guys from my team. Enemy number two.

Towels don't go in the water. Everyone knows that. It's the rule of this battlefield.

Take it off now, and it's all over.

"Nah, early start tomorrow. I'm heading back to the room."

Special move: the Early Retreat. Even a warrior has to know when to fall back.

When I stood up, the knot started to slip.

Right hand on the towel. Left hand on my wash bucket. Body turned toward the wall.

Knee angle. Walking speed. I worked out every detail and made for the exit.

The changing room was empty. I let out a long breath.

I held the line. I won.

Probably.

But as I dried my hair, his voice kept playing back in my head.

"Dude, why are you washing with a towel on?"

Mori didn't mean anything by it. I know that.

Even so, my chest stayed hot the whole time.

He'll invite me to the morning bath tomorrow. I'm sure of it.

The war has only just begun.

---

title: Foreskin Warrior — Episode 2: The Enemy at the Bathhouse
description: Sunday afternoon. I stood in the changing room of a big public bathhouse. In Japan, you wash and soak naked. Everyone does. To me, it's a battlefield.
markdown:
Sunday afternoon. I stood in the changing room of a big public bathhouse, the kind of sento with ten different baths and a sauna.

In Japan, you wash and soak naked. Everyone does. Nobody blinks.

To me, it's a battlefield.

I have one thing to protect.

My tight foreskin. No one sees it. Ever.

Last week, on the company trip, Mori laughed at me at the hot spring, and I retreated. Today was my rematch.

Come alone, and there's no enemy. That was the plan.

"Hey, you're here too?"

A voice behind me. Mori.

Why? Why the same day? Why the same bathhouse?

"It's a five-minute walk from my place. I come every week."

He grinned like it was nothing.

"Huh. Small world."

I fought to keep my voice from cracking.

Mori was already pulling off his clothes. No hesitation at all.

I used my locker door as a shield.

Special move: Door Guard. Slip into the gap between door and wall. Wrap the towel twice around my waist.

Three seconds. Done.

"You still change crazy fast. What are you, a ninja?"

"I've had practice."

Practice hiding, that is.

In the washing area, where you scrub down on a little stool before you get in the bath, I took the shower at the far end.

Special move: Wall Fortress.

Wall on my right. Empty seat on my left. No blind spots.

Then Mori sat in the empty seat.

"Mind if I take this one? The water pressure's great here."

I minded. I minded a lot.

"Sure."

My mouth answered on its own.

Towel still on, I washed from the knees down. I felt Mori glance my way.

Why are you washing with your towel on?

Last week's words echoed in my head.

He hadn't said anything yet. I had to move before he did.

"I'm heading to the sauna."

Special move: Early Retreat. In the sauna, you get to sit on your towel.

Hot. Sweat stung my eyes. But this was a safe zone.

Five minutes later, the door opened.

"You like saunas? Didn't see that coming. Last week you ran straight back to the room."

Mori sat down next to me.

"Bad circulation. I get cold easily."

Special move: The Cold Excuse. Even I didn't know what it meant.

"Does that even have anything to do with saunas?"

Mori tilted his head. Ten minutes passed. My head started to spin.

"Let's hit the cold plunge. Nothing beats it after a sauna."

The cold plunge. A place where the towel comes off.

"Nah, I'm going another round. Today I push to my limit."

Mori left. I sat alone and took the heat.

I hadn't won. But I hadn't lost, either.

My overheated brain decided that was good enough.
